title: Keep cold test topics out of prompts
statement: Keep a ledger of the topics reserved for cold transfer tests, block any generation prompt or exemplar that names one, and retire each topic once it is served.
detail: A reading project's practice-layer specification keeps a cold benchmark that is sealed, drawn from never-taught topics and burned once served, and requires a ledger that keeps those topics out of every generation prompt. The tool built for it runs against every generation prompt and exemplar set before a campaign starts; any hit blocks the campaign until the prompt is scrubbed or the ledger corrected, and a topic is retired once a cold window has served it. A Grade 5 course's generation contract gives the reason: teaching from or gating on the cold pool contaminates the benchmark and turns transfer evidence into rehearsal evidence.
against: The tool matches names and aliases only, so a prompt about "coastal rock basins" would evade a "tide pools" entry; its seeded topics are placeholders; and a retired topic stops gating, a choice the specification leaves open (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/scripts/lane-tools/contamination-ledger/README.md`, lines 64-77).

evidence.quote: Run this tool against **every generation prompt and exemplar set BEFORE a campaign starts**. Any hit blocks the campaign until the prompt is scrubbed or the ledger is corrected.
Supporting clauses: section 2/P5 (cold benchmark = sealed, never-taught topics, burn-after-serve) and section 4 (cold passages are never teaching material).
